dogecoin.text: DogeMarket is a free market for anyone to buy and sell goods, services, and dogecoin. Prices are dictated by the buyers and sellers.

DOGE-Coin is a cryptocurrency featuring a likeness of the Shiba Inu dog from the "Doge" Internet meme as its logo.Introduced as a "joke currency" on 6 December 2013, Dogecoin quickly developed its own online community and reached a capitalization of US$60 million in January 2014.
